boundary.message: The mist turns you back toward the last fire.

content.premise: Ten years ago the great bell of Vesperhold rang for the last time. The gates stayed shut, the guards kept their rounds and a king kept his throne, and none of them can say any longer what they are keeping. A company of hired blades crosses the causeway at dusk to find out what the castle still owes.
content.theme: A Gothic castle whose cracked bell once kept its dead asleep, and whose court has forgotten why it keeps its watch.
content.title: Vesperhold
